title: Remote Host Add Panel validation

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Add Host validation must keep Add Host disabled for idle, testing, invalid, unreachable, SSH-not-ready, and not-Codex-ready destinations, and unlock only after validation succeeds for the same trimmed destination.
Add Host validation must use non-interactive SSH and require Codex CLI, Codex app-server readiness, and writable CodexPill/Codex directories before treating a destination as ready.

targetSurface: CodexPill Add Host form state and fake SSH/Codex readiness contract

nonClaims: Does not prove native Add Host panel screenshot rendering.
Does not prove first responder focus or native click automation.
Does not exercise live SSH, live Codex app-server behavior, or a real remote filesystem.
Does not prove live macOS menu-bar behavior.
